title: Life Insurance
headline: Protect Your Family. Plan for Tomorrow.
intro: Protection planning starts with understanding your responsibilities.

sections.headline: Protect Your Family. Plan for Tomorrow.
sections.copy: Life insurance products differ in purpose, cover, duration, premium, benefits and exclusions. The right choice depends on your circumstances. Contact Lotus Capital to understand the options we can arrange and the information needed to begin.

sections.title: Overview
sections.copy: A structured life insurance plan provides income replacement and family security against premature demise, or builds long-term maturity savings.

sections.title: Insurer Partners
sections.copy: Options available through confirmed life insurers including Bharti AXA Life, HDFC Life, ICICI Prudential, and LIC.

sections.title: Key Considerations
items: Sum assured adequacy relative to family annual expenses and debt
Policy term and premium paying term
Premium affordability over the long term

sections.title: Purchase & Servicing Guide
steps: Initial consultation to assess financial protection needs.
Evaluating suitable options across partner life insurers.
Application documentation and medical underwriting review.
Policy issuance, receipt verification, and annual renewal servicing.

sections.content: Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. Life insurance is not a guaranteed investment return unless explicitly stated in the policy terms. Read all scheme and policy documents carefully.
